run_notes: 2026-10-04: Added 7 new roles (target of 7 met) – 1 consulting (Deloitte Business Transformation Belfast, same scheme as existing Edinburgh listing but a different office/posting), 2 strategy (EY Strategy Public & Private, EY Strategy Financial Services, both London Sept 2027 intake), 4 government-political (Constituency Assistant for Fabian Hamilton MP, Parliamentary Assistant for Iqbal Mohamed MP, Support Officer for Luke Evans MP, Campaign Organiser for Lib Dems Somerset). Removed 0 rejected and 0 expired (30+ days past closing, never applied) – none met either condition today; oldest open closing date is still only ~16 days past. Broadened search across publicaffairsnetworking.com, onthinktanks.org, w4mpjobs.org (3 pages), Bright Network strategy/public-sector-charity categories, PwC/KPMG/Chatham House/IFS/Resolution Foundation/Institute for Government/Fabian Society/Centre for Policy Studies career pages: no new qualifying think-tank or civil-service roles found today – Chatham House's two Research Associate roles had already closed (7 Sept), IFS/Resolution Foundation/IfG/Policy Exchange have no current openings or only internships/postdocs (excluded), and PwC's Graduate Strategy (Economics, Belfast) page mentioned an open role but its own job portal returned no listings so it could not be verified with a working application link. Several w4mp listings (Luke Evans MP Constituency Assistant, Joe Powell MP Junior Caseworker, PF Global Analyst) appeared in search results but returned 'advert deleted from the system' on the detail page, so were excluded per the no-fabrication rule. Civil Service Fast Stream: still closed, confirmed opening midday 8 Oct 2026 – worth checking again once that window opens.
